const cmd = `python3 -B -c '
from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,re
sys.path.insert(0,"tools")
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from i18nlib.lint import MARKUP_RE,AT_TOKEN_RE
P=Path(".ai/task/repair-w16-20260923")
load=LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest()))
a=load.load_path(P/"baseline/mod-tome.lua",logical_path="mod-tome.lua").records
b=load.load_path(Path("mod-tome.lua"),logical_path="mod-tome.lua").records
work=json.loads((P/"WORKSET.json").read_text())["items"]
allowed={(i["section"],i["source"],i["source_tag"]):i for i in work}
changed=[]
for x,y in zip(a,b):
 xx={k:v for k,v in x.items() if k!="line"}; yy={k:v for k,v in y.items() if k!="line"}
 if xx==yy: continue
 key=(x.get("section"),x.get("source"),x.get("source_tag")); assert key in allowed
 assert {k:v for k,v in xx.items() if k!="target"}=={k:v for k,v in yy.items() if k!="target"}
 rev=allowed[key]["entry_revision_identity"]
 for pattern in [r"%[-+ #0]*\\d*(?:\\.\\d+)?[cdeEfgGiouXxqs%]"]:
  assert re.findall(pattern,x["target"])==re.findall(pattern,y["target"])
 assert MARKUP_RE.findall(x["target"])==MARKUP_RE.findall(y["target"])
 assert AT_TOKEN_RE.findall(x["target"])==AT_TOKEN_RE.findall(y["target"])
 if rev.startswith("f14a476f19"):
  assert y["target"].count("\\n")==x["target"].count("\\n")+1
  assert y["target"].count("\\t")==x["target"].count("\\t")
 elif rev.startswith("f15f5593c7"):
  assert y["target"].count("\\n")==x["target"].count("\\n")
  assert all((not line) or line.startswith("\\t\\t") for line in y["target"].split("\\n")[1:])
 else:
  assert y["target"].count("\\n")==x["target"].count("\\n")
  assert y["target"].count("\\t")==x["target"].count("\\t")
 changed.append(rev)
assert len(a)==len(b)==22989
assert len(changed)==7
print(json.dumps({"verified_with_authorized_exceptions":True,"records":len(a),"changed_count":len(changed),"changed_revisions":changed,"exceptions":{"f14a476f19":"target LF +1: required paragraph break","f15f5593c7":"target indentation restored to two TABs on every nonempty continuation line"}},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
'`;
